title: Trainee Associate Civil And Structural Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
TurnBIM Engineering Services is based in Bengaluru, India’s technology hub, and specializes in civil and structural engineering solutions. The company provides BIM services, design and detail engineering, steel detailing, connection design, rebar detailing, and precast detailing, primarily using Tekla Structures. TurnBIM delivers constructible models and comprehensive drawing packages with workshop details for steel and precast fabricators. The team supports clients across India, the US, Europe, Canada, the Middle East, and Australia, focusing on quality, precision, and on-time delivery. TurnBIM emphasizes understanding client requirements and thinking from the customer’s standpoint to provide detail-oriented, reliable service.
  
**Role Description**
The Trainee Associate Civil and Structural Engineer will support project teams in preparing and reviewing structural models and drawings for steel, rebar, and precast elements. This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves assisting senior engineers and detailers with BIM modeling, connection detailing, and constructability checks using tools such as Tekla Structures and related software. Day-to-day responsibilities include interpreting design inputs, updating models, coordinating with project managers and technical modelers, and ensuring adherence to project standards and timelines. The trainee will also help in preparing documentation, performing basic calculations under supervision, and contributing to quality control and revision tracking. The role is designed to provide structured learning and hands-on experience in civil and structural engineering within an international project environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Foundational knowledge of Civil and Structural Engineering principles, including structural analysis and design concepts.
* Familiarity with BIM tools and 3D modeling software (preferably Tekla Structures); exposure to steel and rebar detailing is an advantage.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and construction documents.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy in modeling and documentation, and commitment to quality standards.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with project managers, engineers, and detailers in a team setting.
* Good problem-solving, analytical thinking, and willingness to learn new tools and workflows.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering or a related discipline; internship or academic project experience in structures is beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, manage assigned tasks within deadlines, and adapt to an international client environment.

We build comfortable, ergonomic, durable, value-for-money seating for modern workspaces — owning the full product lifecycle, from consumer research and conceptualisation through design, engineering, prototyping, testing, and mass production. Our work spans chair ergonomics, mechanisms, injection-moulded components, metal structures, PU foam, mesh, and upholstery.

With an expanding portfolio and in-house manufacturing, we're developing innovative office and executive chairs by combining global product insights, engineering strength, and customer feedback.

We're growing our NPD and R&D team — looking for people who can develop new product technologies, sharpen existing designs, and take products from concept to mass production.

**Role Overview:**

Wakefit is looking for a hands-on NPD / R&D Manager to drive the development of new office and executive chairs.

The candidate will be responsible for developing products from concept to mass production, including chair design, ergonomics, mechanism development, material selection, prototyping, and manufacturing feasibility.

We are looking for someone who can study global products and technologies, identify proven solutions that can be adapted to our products, and develop innovative, comfortable, durable and cost-effective office chairs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Research & Development**

• Study international office chair brands, products, designs and emerging technologies.

• Identify innovative features, mechanisms, and existing technologies that can be adapted to Wakefit products.

• Explore opportunities to integrate already-developed mechanisms and components to reduce development time and cost.

• Develop new office and executive chair designs based on consumer needs and market trends.

**2. Product Design & Engineering**

• Develop chair structures, seats, backrests, armrests, headrests, and lumbar support systems.

• Identify suitable materials, components and manufacturing processes.

• Work with mould manufacturers and component vendors for new product development.

• Explore opportunities for component commonality and cost optimisation.

**4. Prototyping & Testing**

• Develop physical prototypes and drive design improvements.

• Test chairs for comfort, stability, strength and durability.

• Identify product failures and work on corrective actions.

• Ensure products meet required quality and performance standards.

**5. Cross-functional Coordination & Manufacturing**

• Work closely with the Quality team to define testing requirements, validate products and resolve quality issues.

• Coordinate with the Purchase team for vendor identification, component sourcing, cost negotiations, and supplier development.

• Work with manufacturing teams to ensure designs are production-ready.

• Coordinate with mould manufacturers for tooling and mould development.

• Ensure smooth transition from product development to mass production.

**6. NPD Execution**

• Own the development process from initial concept to mass production.

• Prepare BOMs, engineering drawings, and product specifications.

• Manage development timelines, vendor dependencies, and prototype iterations.

• Drive faster product development by leveraging existing designs, components, and proven technologies.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• Proficiency in SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA or similar CAD software.

• Understanding of injection moulding and plastic component development.

• Knowledge of metal fabrication, PU foam and other manufacturing processes.

• Experience in product prototyping and testing.

• Good problem-solving and project management skills.

• Ability to work with cross-functional teams and external vendors.

• Office furniture and chair manufacturing.

• Automotive seating and interiors.

title: Customer Experience & Retention Manager
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
**About The Role**
Harness is growing its Digital and Commercial customer base, and we will not scale it by adding people in proportion. This role owns
**customer experience and retention for a large book of Digital and Commercial customers**
, and its main job is to
**build and run the tech-touch engine that serves them**
.
  
  
You will design automated journeys, health signals, in-product and email programs, and self-service resources that deliver onboarding, adoption, risk detection, renewal and expansion without a person in every interaction. You will use human time on the moments that matter: a customer stuck on a technical blocker, an at-risk account, a renewal negotiation. You will also feed what you learn back into the automation so those moments become rarer.
  
  
**Operating principle:**
Automate by default, involve a human by exception. Every manual touch should either solve a high-value problem or teach us what to automate next.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Tech-Touch Customer Experience Engine
* Design, scale and optimize automated lifecycle programs: onboarding, activation, adoption, renewal and win-back. Run them through the CRM, the CS platform, email and in-product channels. Build triggered plays driven by product usage, milestones, health score, support signals and contract events.
* Own the segmentation and coverage model: which customers get automation only, automation plus on-demand human help, or direct engagement.
* Build the self-service layer: guides, templates, pipeline examples, office hours, webinars, community content and a knowledge base. Measure what gets used and fill the gaps.
* Run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, timing and channel) and report on what changes adoption and retention.
* Use AI-assisted workflows for summarisation, content personalisation, ticket and usage insight, and outreach drafting to raise throughput without losing quality.
* Data-Driven Health, Risk & Prioritisation
* Own the customer health model: define, validate and tune the signals (usage depth, feature adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment and commercial indicators).
* Turn the data into automated risk and opportunity alerts, and route them to the right play or person. Build dashboards that show portfolio health, coverage efficiency, adoption funnels and renewal risk. Run recovery plans for at-risk accounts, then capture the pattern as a repeatable, automated play.
* Technical Enablement & Hands-On Support
* Guide customers through product configuration, integrations (GitHub, GitLab, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools) and common pipeline issues when automation and self-service are not enough.
* Join technical discovery and proof-of-value work with Solutions Engineering and forward-deployed teams.
* Reproduce common issues, gather logs and configuration details, and escalate cleanly to Support and Engineering.
* Convert every recurring technical question into reusable enablement: a guide, template, in-product prompt or automated play.
* Turn recurring customer challenges into product feedback and prioritised requests.
* Renewals, Retention & Commercial Ownership
* Own renewal execution end to end: automated renewal journeys and reminders, risk assessment, commercial discussion and close, with human involvement focused on at-risk and strategic renewals. Identify expansion, cross-sell and right-sizing opportunities from usage signals, and trigger plays and handoffs to Account Executives.
* Coordinate quotes, Order Forms, approvals and procurement with internal stakeholders. Keep renewal forecasts, customer records and risk assessments accurate and current. Work with Account Executives and Revenue Operations to improve gross revenue retention and reduce preventable churn.
* Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Partnership
* Work with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Revenue Operations to connect data, systems and messaging across the customer journey.
* Find manual, repetitive tasks and remove them through automation, integrations and tooling. Document playbooks and share best practices so the model scales across teams and segments.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years required (5+ years preferred) in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Digital/Scaled CS, Solutions Consulting or a similar SaaS role. Experience managing a high-volume B2B SaaS portfolio, ideally in a digital, SMB, mid-market or commercial segment.
* Hands-on experience building automation in a CRM or CS platform (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Totango or similar), including journeys, triggers and health scoring.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with usage and engagement data, dashboards, funnels and cohort or segment analysis.
* Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals: Git, CI/CD pipelines, APIs and cloud platforms. Experience with SaaS renewals, retention and commercial discussions, and an understanding of subscription, licensing and billing models.
* Strong communication, troubleshooting and prioritisation skills in a high-volume environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with digital CS tooling: in-app guidance, email and marketing automation, community platforms and knowledge-base or content systems.
* Experience using SQL, BI tools, scripting or low-code automation to build and improve workflows. Experience applying AI or LLM-assisted workflows to customer communication, support or insight. Hands-on exposure to Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD platforms. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or GCP; REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and YAML configuration.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or DevSecOps concepts.
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects or implementation teams.

**What Success Looks Like**
**Area**
**Outcomes**
**Scale & efficiency**
Higher customers-per-manager coverage with stable or improving satisfaction. A growing share of lifecycle touches and renewals handled through automation. Fewer repeat manual tasks.
  
  
**Adoption &**
**Experience**
Faster onboarding and time to value, higher activation and feature adoption, and measurable use of self-service content.
  
  
**Retention &**
**commercial**
Improved gross revenue retention, lower preventable churn, accurate renewal forecasts and expansion opportunities identified from signals.
  
  
**Risk & health**
Earlier risk detection through a validated health model, and more recoveries run from standard plays.
  
  
**Technical**
Routine technical questions resolved through self-service or by you, and less reliance on Engineering for them.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
You think in systems, not accounts. You are as comfortable building a triggered journey and reading a usage cohort as you are leading a renewal conversation or debugging a CI/CD workflow with a developer. You do not need to be a software developer, but you are curious about how customers build and ship software, and you ask what a repeated touch tells you about what to automate or fix in the product.
  
  
**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
  
  
At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/
  
  
**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
  
  
Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
  
  
If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. About the Opportunity

VEGAH is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking, highly independent, and hands-on SAP technical professional with strong expertise in SAP Basis, S/4HANA, HANA, enterprise cloud environments, production operations, complex SAP landscapes, and technical transformations.

This position is designed for an individual who combines
**deep engineering expertise with technical leadership, proactive ownership, operational discipline, and a continuous-improvement mindset**
.

The ideal candidate is naturally curious, progressive in adopting modern technologies, decisive under pressure, and capable of identifying and resolving problems without waiting for detailed instructions.

**This is not a monitoring-only, ticket-routing, or coordination-only position. We expect a hands-on technical leader who takes initiative, demonstrates sound judgment, and drives technical activities through completion.**

**Core Technical Responsibilities**

**SAP Basis, S/4HANA & HANA**

* Independently perform SAP Basis administration, diagnostics, and technical troubleshooting across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, ABAP Platform, and HANA landscapes.
* Diagnose work-process failures, short dumps, background job failures, update terminations, RFC issues, connectivity failures, performance degradation, and system availability problems.
* Perform proactive system health assessments, preventive maintenance, housekeeping, capacity assessments, and performance investigations.
* Support SAP Fiori, Gateway, ICM, Web Dispatcher, SSL certificates, technical users, and application connectivity.
* Investigate HANA performance problems, expensive SQL, memory utilization, locks, and application/database bottlenecks.
* Coordinate remediation with authorized infrastructure, database, security, and application teams.

**SAP Landscape Architecture, HA & Disaster Recovery**

* Demonstrate hands-on involvement in designing, operating, or supporting complex multi-system SAP landscapes.
* Understand DEV, QA, pre-production, production, sandbox, and disaster recovery environments.
* Work with high-availability architectures, application-server redundancy, load balancing, SAP HANA System Replication, clustering concepts, and failover dependencies.
* Participate in HA/DR readiness assessments, recovery testing, failover drills, and post-recovery validations.
* Understand RPO, RTO, recovery sequencing, system dependencies, and business continuity considerations.
* Troubleshoot system availability and recovery incidents, including coordination across SAP, infrastructure, database, network, and application teams.
* Develop and maintain disaster recovery runbooks, recovery checklists, operational playbooks, and technical escalation procedures.
* Identify single points of failure, operational risks, capacity constraints, and opportunities to improve system resilience.

**SAP Migrations, Conversions, Upgrades & Technical Transformations**

* Demonstrate genuine hands-on involvement in SAP migrations, ECC-to-S/4HANA conversions, upgrades, system copies, and complex technical transformations.
* Work with SUM, DMO, SWPM, and relevant SAP lifecycle management tools.
* Participate in architecture assessments, technical planning, prerequisite checks, downtime optimization, cutover execution, troubleshooting, validation, and hypercare.
* Diagnose complex conversion, upgrade, transport, and migration failures.
* Coordinate across technical, infrastructure, functional, security, integration, and application teams.
* Identify risks early and develop preventive mitigation plans rather than waiting for problems to occur.

**SAP Solution Manager, Cloud ALM & Enterprise ITSM**

* Demonstrate practical experience with SAP Solution Manager, including monitoring, ChaRM, ITSM, or comparable lifecycle capabilities.
* Work with SAP Cloud ALM for health monitoring, exception monitoring, integration monitoring, job monitoring, alerting, and reporting.
* Manage incident, problem, change, and service-request processes through ServiceNow, Jira, SAP support platforms, or equivalent ITSM tools.
* Establish monitoring thresholds, escalation workflows, technical reporting, and operational dashboards.
* Own ticket prioritization, resolution coordination, SLA tracking, and recurring-problem elimination.
* Identify opportunities to automate monitoring, ticket classification, alert enrichment, and reporting.

**Critical Incident & P1 Recovery Leadership**

* Demonstrate proven experience personally resolving critical production incidents, including P1 incidents restored within 30 minutes where the underlying fault and authorized recovery actions permitted.
* Independently take command of production incidents, assess business impact, isolate technical failures, and coordinate resolution.
* Initiate structured P1 investigation and escalation within 30 minutes of notification during agreed coverage hours.
* Demonstrate the ability to distinguish application, database, network, integration, and infrastructure-related failure domains.
* Lead incident bridges with technical specialists, stakeholders, and enterprise leadership.
* Implement approved recovery actions promptly, while respecting production access, change controls, and rollback procedures.
* Maintain clear incident communications, timelines, recovery checkpoints, and escalation updates.
* Conduct root-cause analysis, document lessons learned, and eliminate repeat incidents through corrective actions.
* Remain composed, decisive, and technically effective under high-pressure production conditions.

**Candidates must be able to explain real P1 incidents they personally resolved, including incident timelines, diagnostic evidence, recovery decisions, business impact, and prevention measures.**

Security, Integration, Data & Technical Administration

* Support SAP technical security, administrative access controls, identity integration, certificates, and SAP Security Notes.
* Understand SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, Fiori, Gateway, APIs, and enterprise integration dependencies.
* Troubleshoot technical interface failures and coordinate cross-system resolution.
* Support transport management, approved deployments, technical changes, and release validation.
* Monitor application performance, data growth, technical tables, storage utilization, and housekeeping requirements.
* Understand data archiving, partitioning, Native Storage Extension, and related technical data management concepts.
* Maintain strong operational awareness of the responsibilities and authorization boundaries across application, database, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams.

**Operational Leadership, Autonomy & Accountability**

We place significant emphasis on the candidate's work ethic, judgment, initiative, and leadership qualities.

The successful professional must demonstrate:

* **Independent ownership:**
  Work confidently with minimal supervision, identify next steps, and drive assigned responsibilities to completion.
* **Proactive mindset:**
  Anticipate operational risks, identify recurring patterns, and address concerns before they escalate.
* **Forward thinking:**
  Continuously assess opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
* **Bias for action:**
  Take appropriate initiative rather than waiting for repeated instructions or reminders.
* **Accountability:**
  Own outcomes, communicate blockers early, and follow through on commitments.
* **Positive attitude:**
  Approach technical challenges constructively and maintain composure under pressure.
* **Team orientation:**
  Collaborate respectfully with engineers, functional consultants, stakeholders, and external providers.
* **Sound technical judgment:**
  Know when to act independently and when production safety, approvals, or specialist expertise require escalation.
* **Adaptability:**
  Learn new SAP technologies, cloud tools, automation techniques, and operational processes.
* **Customer confidence:**
  Communicate professionally with enterprise stakeholders and explain technical matters clearly.

Candidates who are comfortable only with reactive ticket processing or require continuous task-by-task direction will not be a strong fit for this role.

Team Development, Knowledge Management & Standardization

* Mentor, coach, and technically guide junior and mid-level SAP engineers.
* Conduct structured knowledge-transfer sessions, technical walkthroughs, and troubleshooting workshops.
* Develop and maintain
  **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, incident playbooks, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, and recovery checklists**
  .
* Build reusable documentation for SAP Basis administration, monitoring, transports, upgrades, migrations, HA/DR, and common incident scenarios.

* Encourage cross-training, knowledge sharing, and technical collaboration.

Automation, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

* Implement practical improvements using Python, PowerShell, shell scripting, APIs, or approved enterprise automation tools.
* Develop automated monitoring checks, alert enrichment, reporting workflows, and standard diagnostic routines.
* Apply data-driven approaches to incident trend analysis, anomaly detection, and capacity planning.

* Continuously seek opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve recovery times, and increase operational reliability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–10 years of relevant SAP Basis and enterprise technical operations experience, with demonstrated depth in production systems.
* Strong hands-on SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, and HANA expertise.
* Proven experience participating in complex SAP migrations, conversions, upgrades, or major technical transformations.
* Exposure to complex SAP landscapes, high availability, and disaster recovery operations.
* Practical SAP Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM knowledge.
* Experience with enterprise incident, change, problem, and service management.
* Proven involvement in high-priority production incident resolution.
* Strong technical troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and recovery skills.
* Ability to independently lead technical activities and coordinate cross-functional teams.
* Experience developing SOPs, runbooks, technical documentation, and operational playbooks.
* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to work consistently during US Central Time business hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP private cloud, hybrid cloud, or managed enterprise SAP environments.
* Hands-on HA/DR implementation or recovery testing.
* HANA System Replication, SAP application clustering, and failover troubleshooting.
* SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, Integration Suite, Fiori, Gateway, and connectivity expertise.
* SAP Security Notes, technical security, and access governance.
* Automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or enterprise workflow tools.
* Experience implementing technical monitoring improvements and AI-assisted operations.
* Experience leading a small technical team while continuing to perform hands-on work.
* Relevant SAP certifications supported by verifiable practical experience.

**Essential Professional Attributes**

We are especially interested in professionals who demonstrate:

**Ownership over supervision. Initiative over instruction. Prevention over reaction. Execution over discussion. Collaboration over silos.**

The ideal candidate is energetic, dependable, self-directed, technically curious, and motivated to build better operational practices.

We value professionals who take pride in solving difficult problems, supporting teammates, developing others, and continuously improving the systems and processes they manage.

Technical Evaluation

Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss and demonstrate:

1. **Three real P1 production incidents**
   , including at least one personally resolved within approximately 30 minutes, with evidence of the actual recovery actions taken.
2. Their involvement in complex SAP HA/DR architecture, failover, or disaster recovery testing.
3. Two significant SAP migrations, S/4HANA conversions, or upgrade engagements.
4. A complex SAP performance or availability issue personally diagnosed and resolved.
5. Practical experience with SAP Solution Manager, Cloud ALM, and enterprise ticketing.
6. An operational automation they personally designed or implemented.
7. Runbooks, SOPs, technical playbooks, or knowledge-transfer materials they created.
8. Examples of mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, and independently improving service quality.

Candidates must clearly distinguish between activities they personally executed, those they coordinated, and those performed by other specialists.

**Growth Opportunity**

title: Junior Associate - Design Researcher
description:
**Junior Associate - Design Researcher**

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a Design Researcher with about 1 year of experience who can look at any design, say clearly why it works or fails, and turn that into layout rules our designers can use.

Job title : Design Researcher

Experience : 1 year

Employment type : Full-time

Location : Bangalore

Works with : UI/UX designers, graphic designers, developers, account managers

**About this Role**

This role sits between thinking and making. You will not be judged mainly on how many screens or posters you produce. You will be judged on how well you study, explain and systemise design.

You should be someone who loves talking about designs. Show you a brochure, a website or a mobile app screen, and you can explain:

* **What kind of design it is**
  — UI design, UX design, graphic design, or a mix — and why that difference matters for how it is judged.
* **How the layout is built**
  — grid, columns, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, type scale and visual flow.
* **Why it works for its industry**
  — what that industry's audience needs to see first, and whether the design delivers it.

Your research becomes the playbook our designers follow when they start a new project in any industry vertical.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Speak and explain design**

* Break down any design (website, app, brochure, social post, hoarding) and explain its intent, structure and weaknesses in plain language.
* Present design reviews to designers, account managers and clients, and defend design decisions with clear reasoning.
* Write short design rationales that go along with every major deliverable.

**2. Classify the type of design**

* Identify whether a brief needs UI design, UX design, graphic design, or a combination.
* Explain the difference to non-designers: UX is how it works and flows, UI is how the interface looks and behaves, graphic design is visual communication for print, social and brand.
* Recommend the right skill mix and process for each project.

**3. Dive deep into layout systems**

* Study and document grid systems (12-column web grids, modular grids, baseline grids, 8-pt spacing systems).
* Analyse visual hierarchy, typography scales, white space, alignment, and reading patterns such as F-pattern and Z-pattern.
* Build reusable layout templates and component rules for websites, landing pages, brochures and social creatives.
* Audit existing work against these systems and flag inconsistencies.

**4. Research vertical-based design**

* Build design playbooks for each industry vertical the team works on.
* Study competitors, award-winning work and current trends in each vertical, and summarise what works.
* Map what each vertical's audience needs to see, in what order, and translate that into layout guidance.
* Keep a living reference library (mood boards, swipe files, annotated examples) per vertical.

**5. Support design and research work**

* Run light user research: short surveys, usability checks, heatmap and analytics reviews, stakeholder interviews.
* Help designers with wireframes, layout drafts and reference packs before visual design starts.
* Share findings in short decks or docs and run occasional internal design talks.

**Verticals and design work you will cover**

You will research design across every industry vertical we work in, and any new one we take on. For each vertical, you study the audience, competitors and design conventions, then turn them into layout guidance for the work types below.

**1. Graphic design**

What you will study: Brochures, print ads, outdoor and hoardings, social media creatives, campaign key visuals, brand collateral.

Layout focus: Visual hierarchy, typography, image-to-text balance, brand consistency across formats.

**2. Web design**

What you will study: Websites, microsites, landing pages, listing and detail pages.

Layout focus: Grid systems, section order, responsive behaviour, CTA and form placement.

**3. UI/UX design**

What you will study: App screens, user flows, forms, enquiry, booking and checkout journeys, dashboards.

Layout focus: Navigation, information architecture, interaction patterns, usability and accessibility.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* About 1 year of experience in design research, UI/UX design, graphic design, or a design-strategy role (internships count).
* Degree or diploma in design, visual communication, HCI, architecture, fine arts, or equivalent portfolio.
* Strong ability to
  **speak about design**
  — clear, confident explanation of why a layout, colour or type choice works.
* Clear understanding of the difference between UI design, UX design and graphic design.
* Solid grasp of layout fundamentals: grids, spacing systems, hierarchy, typography, alignment and white space.
* Working knowledge of Figma; basic use of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign.
* Good written English for design rationales, research summaries and presentations.
* A portfolio or case study that shows research thinking, not only final visuals.

**Nice to have**

* Experience creating or maintaining a design system or component library.
* Familiarity with research and analytics tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics, Maze or Notion.
* Experience giving design talks, writing design blogs or running workshops.
* Comfort in English plus one regional language for client and user conversations.

**Hiring Process and How to Apply**

1. **Portfolio review**
   — share a portfolio with at least one case study that shows your research and reasoning.
2. **Design talk-through (30 min)**
   — we show you two designs from different verticals, one website and one print piece. You explain the type of design, the layout system behind it, and what you would improve.
3. **Take-home task (3–4 hours)**
   — pick a website from any vertical and write a one-page layout teardown: grid, hierarchy, section order, lead-form placement, and three specific improvements.
4. **Final conversation**
   — meet the Design Lead and team.

To apply: send your CV and portfolio link to [hiring email] with the subject line "Design Researcher – [Your Name]".

The team delivers both tracking and adhoc studies across consumer and B2B, research, for well-known clients. You'll be involved in every stage of a project, from inception to delivery, and you'll get to present data back to clients directly rather than working behind the scenes.
  
  
**What will I be doing day-to-day?**

* Assisting and designing with questionnaire design and reporting insight across projects, ensuring they meet objectives and reflect best research practice
* Managing projects end-to-end: from inception, through fieldwork monitoring and swift issue resolution, to delivering results and clearly communicating what the research shows — including taking clients through Crunch, our online data tool
* Liaising with clients and collaborators on all day-to-day aspects of projects, including reviewing client-created materials (e.g. press releases, reports) to ensure results are accurately reported and stand up to external scrutiny
* Working with senior researchers on larger, high-profile quantitative and global projects, and supporting other researchers on Insight projects across a range of sectors and specialisms
* Supporting commercial teams on fast-turnaround client requests — assessing feasibility, helping with quotes, and assisting with client calls or pitches
* Learning and using YouGov's technical systems, including logging client activity, recording project communications, and scripting surveys to deliver results to clients

**What's in it for me?**
You will be a key team member for the delivery of research to clients. Working on both ad hoc projects and trackers, you will help develop questionnaires, manage fieldwork, undertake analysis and tell the story of clients' data — with genuine exposure to both sector specialism and high-volume, fast-turnaround research.
  
  
**What do I need to bring with me?**
**Demonstrated Knowledge And Experience**

* A strong interest, enthusiasm and passion for research and insight
* Quantitative research experience (not necessary but desirable), with a basic understanding of primary research methods, particularly online research
* Excellent focus and handling skills, with the ability to deliver results, meet deadlines and manage time effectively
* Outstanding attention to detail
* An understanding of statistics and quantitative analysis is desirable
* Self-motivated and confident

**Technical Skills And Qualifications**

* Educated up to degree / HND level in a relevant subject — desirable, not essential
* Experience using MS Office
* Excellent written, oral and electronic communication skills

**Behavioural competencies**

* Enjoys working within a vibrant and dynamic team environment; curious, with a desire and eagerness to learn and solve problems
* Approachable and supportive, with strong communication and interpersonal skills to get your point across with the team, wider colleagues and clients
* Priority setting — focusing on what matters to get the right things done
* Solution focused — proactively identifying change and improvements, e.g. around processes
* Accountability and ownership of your work and complex tasks

Shift Timings : 2 PM - 11 PM

description:
**About The Team**
the^delta Prize is a platform to draw talent, capital, and public attention towards the most pressing developmental problems in India. the^delta Prize aims to guide markets where they are needed the most, inducing population-scale solutions and innovations that have disproportionate impact on stagnant livelihood opportunities and ecosystems for underserved segments.
  
  
This role sits within Future Enterprises, the^delta Prize's vertical dedicated to India's MSME sector, and supports the AI platform within Samriddhi (AI for MSME prosperity). The platform connects youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities to career pathways, skilling, apprenticeships and jobs, while helping MSMEs access job-ready talent. The role reports to the Senior Manager, Platform, and works alongside the Director / Associate Director, AI & Digital Platforms and the Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem teams.

Youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities, whose access to career guidance, skilling and jobs is limited by language, geography and the thin guidance available to them, and MSMEs that find it difficult to reach job-ready talent.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
India's youth-to-work transition is fragmented: skilling remains supply-led while MSME demand for talent goes largely unmet, career guidance for tier 3–4 youth is thin and rarely available in their own language, and the landscape of job and skilling platforms is fragmented across incompatible systems. * High comfort with ambiguity and change

description:
*Run the marketplace business of an 80-year-old Ayurveda brand, and build the AI tools that help run it.*

Kerala Ayurveda | Reports to: Head of Analytics | Location: Whitefield, Bangalore (onsite)

**About the role**

Kerala Ayurveda is one of India’s oldest Ayurveda brands, with over 80 years of heritage. We are a listed, full-spectrum Ayurveda company: we make our own products and run clinics, hospitals, wellness resorts and academies across India, the US and Southeast Asia.

Our marketplace business on Amazon India, Amazon US and Flipkart is a growth engine, and you will own it: its revenue and ad efficiency, its ads and planning, and the way that work gets done.

**One role, two halves**

**OPERATE · 50%:**
Run the marketplace day to day: campaigns and bids, search terms, the monthly plan, and the weekly and monthly business reviews.

**BUILD · 50%:**
Make that work faster and sharper. Build and improve the AI workflows, tools and dashboards we run on. Decide when their output can be trusted, and fix them when it cannot.

The tools you will work on include the ads automation tool, the root-cause analysis app, the WBR agent, and the content and image pipelines.

We want both skills in one person. Running ads well is not enough on its own, and neither is building tools without the operating experience to judge them.

**Who you work with**

You report to the Head of Analytics and work side by side with the Chief Business Officer (CBO). You own delivery against the marketplace revenue and ad-efficiency targets; the CBO signs off the targets and the monthly plan. When the plan and the data disagree, you call it early, with numbers.

**What you will run**

* **Own the number.**
  Marketplace revenue and ad-efficiency delivery on Amazon India, Amazon US and Flipkart, end to end.
* **Run the ads.**
  Structure Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns by brand, generic and competitor intent. Harvest search terms, manage negatives, and tune bids and budgets against ROAS and revenue goals.
* **Find the next growth.**
  Under-invested products that convert well, high-intent searches where we do not rank yet, and new categories. Partner with the content and brand teams on the formats and creatives each campaign needs.
* **Set the plan.**
  Build the monthly plan by product and campaign, forecast revenue and ROAS by scenario, and flag early when targets conflict.
* **Explain what moved.**
  Build and present the Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews. Run root-cause analysis on revenue movements, act on the drivers, and double down on what works.

**What you will build**

* **Sharpen our AI tools.**
  Improve the internal AI workflows and tools behind ads operations, reporting and root-cause analysis, including the budget and bid optimiser, the WBR agent and the RCA app.
* **Scale content and creatives.**
  Build and improve the content and image pipelines the team uses for listings and creatives.
* **Automate the grind.**
  Automate the recurring work you do by hand. Set the checks that decide when a tool’s output gets used, and keep a log of where it got things wrong.
* **Ship it properly.**
  Name the requester, agree what “done” means, and document it so others can run it without you.

**What you bring on day one**

* **Experience:**
  4+ years in e-commerce, marketplace or performance marketing, with at least 3 years owning revenue or ad targets and budgets on Amazon India, Amazon US or Flipkart. Agency work counts if you held the account target and can show the result.
* **Ad funnel fluency:**
  CTR, CPC, CVR, ROAS and TACoS, and at least one target you have owned, with where it started and where you took it.
* **SQL:**
  a good understanding of SQL, and you can write and debug queries on your own, from joins and CTEs to window functions.
* **A builder’s track record:**
  a process, report or tool you have improved at least once, with the before and after. A script, a formula chain or an AI workflow all count.
* **Judgement with data and AI:**
  a method for checking any tool’s output before you act on it, and a data trap you have caught and how you handled it.

**Your first 90 days**

* **Weeks 1–2:**
  Learn our ads automation tool and its budget and bid optimiser. Review a past week’s logs in read-only mode and name one rule you would change.
* **Weeks 1–4:**
  Get to know our marketplace traffic and search data, known traps included.
* **Weeks 3–6:**
  Run our Amazon India root-cause workflow and the Flipkart root-cause app on real revenue movements. The Amazon US diagnostic is a build target within these 90 days.
* **Weeks 5–8:**
  Run the monthly ASIN-level plan cycle with the CBO.
* **Weeks 7–12:**
  Take on the WBR agent, and one internal workflow you own end to end.

**By day 90,**
you own the monthly plan cycle and the WBR, and you have shipped at least one change to an internal AI workflow, with a written note on its failure modes.

**Good to have**

* Flipkart Ads or Amazon US experience
* Python
* Helium 10 and Amazon Brand Analytics
* D2C, FMCG, beauty or wellness background
* Presenting business reviews to a CBO or leadership team

None of these will screen you out.

**Strong ads operator? Apply.**

If you have run Amazon Ads well, we want to hear from you. Our tools are learnable; what we screen for is the habit of making work better. Use AI to move faster, check what it gives you before you act, and show us how you do it.

**How to apply**

1. **Apply on Linkedin**
2. **Shortlist:**
   we review applications and shortlist candidates.
3. **Assignment:**
   a practical screening exercise on marketplace data. AI tools are allowed; include a one-page method note on what you used and how you checked it. Take the time you need; we weigh reasoning over polish.
4. **Interview:**
   walk the Head of Analytics and the CBO through your assignment and one workflow from your application.

You will hear from us within 2 to 4 weeks of applying.

* Sort and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, risk exposure, impacted service, asset criticality and SLA requirements.

* Monitor vulnerability trends and identify recurring systemic issues that may require broader service improvement actions.

* Experience developing management reporting, service metrics and process improvement actions.

**Your Impact**

Provide targeted training, technical guidance, and knowledge-sharing sessions to enable TAC teams. This includes structured training throughout the year, as well as ad hoc sessions and Q&A (live and via Zoom). Maintain regular office hours with support teams to facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and faster issue resolution.
* Adaptability & Initiative: Take ownership of emerging technical challenges, adapt to evolving products and responsibilities. Champion unplanned projects that result in a better customer experience, and proactively identify opportunities to improve customer support and engineering workflows.

**The Team**
Customer Engineering is a specialized technical team that is critical to our success and mission. Our technical team provides behind-the-scenes support to meet our customer’s needs. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. We’re a fast-growing, immensely successful organization because of our people and products. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, are excited by the prospect of a challenge, and feel empowered to mitigate the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are enabled by a secure digital environment.

**Required Qualifications**

* Professional Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Troubleshooting & Escalations: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with experience investigating complex technical issues and handling critical escalations in enterprise environments. Ability to work effectively under pressure and coordinate investigations across multiple teams.
* Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical findings, managing customer expectations, and engaging with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders. Translating technical information for other Engineers and Executive teams is an essential part of the job.
* Cloud & SaaS Knowledge: Understanding of enterprise SaaS architectures, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operational workflows. Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Scripting, Automation, and AI: Comfortable with Python, JSON, REST APIs, Linux/Unix environments, SQL, SDKs, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) to automate lab deployments and build custom troubleshooting scripts. Proficiency with SOTA AI models (such as Claude and ChatGPT) in coding and engineering workflows. Experience developing AI-assisted troubleshooting workflows, automation agents, or internal engineering tools is highly desired.
* SaaS/SRE/DevOps Knowledge: Familiarity or experience with enterprise SaaS application backend systems, DevOps, SRE, and CI/CD pipelines is required.
* Networking & Security Fundamentals: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, routing, and general network troubleshooting.

Experience with incident management processes is beneficial. Familiarity with incident management tools such as PagerDuty or FireHydrant is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Knowledge of core NGFW capabilities such as App-ID, User-ID, Threat Prevention, and URL Filtering across physical, virtual, and cloud-delivered environments.
